result.summary: The image depicts an urban street with a marked zebra crosswalk and a dedicated bike lane. The environment features a mix of commercial and residential land uses, including a gas station with multiple curb cuts that create conflict points for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Gas station conflict zone
hazards.description: The sidewalk is interrupted by wide gas station aprons, creating multiple points of potential conflict between pedestrians and vehicles entering or exiting the station.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the sidewalk meets the gas station lot.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple travel lanes and a bike lane without a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the roadway in stages.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width and number of curb cuts for the gas station to minimize conflict points and maintain sidewalk continuity.

result.summary: The image shows a standard urban intersection with marked high-visibility crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide sidewalks. While basic infrastructure is present, the environment lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands to shorten crossing distances.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway in one stage without a protected waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a marked crosswalk that is significantly faded. The environment lacks active pedestrian controls like signals or high-visibility signage, and parked cars may limit sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the crossing on the right side of the street may block the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, near the crosswalk

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk across a three-lane one-way street. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks visible pedestrian signals and requires crossing multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three lanes of one-way traffic without a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: The gas station entrance creates a point where vehicles may cross the pedestrian walkway unexpectedly.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
